canonical_title: No versioned function registry with provenance tracking
canonical_definition: Families 5, 6, 10 show that adapters, merged models, and agent skills all require versioned registries with provenance. Ignition tracks versions via git but has no machine-readable registry.

direct_evidence.summary: S120-035 (LoRA, VERIFIED) manages adapter pools. S120-039 (Model Soups, VERIFIED) collects checkpoints. S120-045 (Task Arithmetic, VERIFIED) manipulates model weights.

structural_evidence.summary: S120-017/018 show structural versioning via synthesis.

negative_evidence.summary: No unified machine-verifiable provenance model across representation types. Versioning is implicit or ad-hoc.

supported_claims: Versioned pools of adapters, checkpoints, and skills are demonstrated
Registry concepts exist across federated learning, LoRA, model soups, and skill libraries
unsupported_claims: No unified provenance model across representation types
residual_gap: Most strongly supported GAP. Building blocks exist but lack unified provenance and interoperability standards.
confidence_basis: MEDIUM-HIGH. Three VERIFIED sources directly demonstrate versioned registry concepts. Building blocks are concrete.
recommended_next_action: Build N9 (VersionedRegistry) as highest-priority implementation. Use LoRA adapter pools and model soups as design templates.
prohibited_wording: Do not claim 'the registry is fully implemented' or 'provenance is solved'. Building blocks exist; integration does not.
